Spec: verify payment webhooks before acting on them.
Every incoming Stripe webhook must have its signature checked against the endpoint secret before any
handler runs. Unsigned or badly signed events are rejected with a 400 and logged. The raw event body is
stored exactly as received so a later dispute can be replayed against the same bytes. Charges are only
marked paid after a verified checkout.session.completed event; refunds only after a verified
charge.refunded event. Duplicate event ids are ignored so a retry never double-charges a customer.
